policy_presence.summary: Official generative AI guidance and scope boundaries for University of Alberta are retained in local candidate evidence pending independent presentation review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Check the particular assessment for disclosure and citation instructions; a uniform formula has not been verified.

coursework.summary: AI permission is set by instructors or programs for the particular course or assignment.

exams.summary: No independently verified university-wide AI exam permission or prohibition in this review.

privacy_data_entry.summary: CCID Gemini is institutionally approved for defined data use; high-risk data must not be shared, and other tools are not authorized for university data.

academic_integrity.summary: Misuse of AI applications for academic advantage can fall under contract cheating; outcomes require separate formal procedures.

approved_tools.summary: Gemini is identified for institutional data use, which does not grant student assignment permission. NotebookLM entitlement needs fresh verification.

named_ai_services.summary: Named AI services for University of Alberta are retained as discovery records pending independent presentation review; service availability does not grant assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: The university discourages AI detection applications and requires privacy/security review for department or faculty exceptions.

research_guidance.summary: Grant-development guidance was located in historical tracker evidence, but its full current text was not independently obtained.

security_procurement.summary: Gemini approval applies to university data under the published data-safety guide; other services are not thereby approved.
